authoringNotes: Exact frame-0 source geometry, side-labelled source skeleton, source input SHA and pinned qualitative movement/action locator retained.
The ipsilateral clavicle, scapula, humerus, radius/ulna and distal chain share the authored pose only as passive skeletal context; it is not a claim of normal shoulder rhythm or muscle activation.

Girdle and trunk-to-humerus muscle masks are reproducible nearest-source-surface distance fields between exact source bone meshes. Endpoint pins are authored constraints, not measured attachment footprints or pivot/normal-axis data.
Muscle surfaces wholly within the co-moving limb chain follow the chain rigidly as passive context; this is not a muscle contraction demo.
Source-only, local technical use only, public redistribution held, human review not performed, and canonical binding absent.
Native latissimus is passively deformed with explicit held broad axial/lower mask and native humeral end; original rigid carriage is not treated as a correct attachment model.
